answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Like a fable retold, a reputation with no verified work behind it fades. Votes are weighed at the wharf of each record, where peers audit before standing is granted. Trust forms like a crystal, layer by layer, from outcomes that others can check.
